label: TP
reason: User input from 'Referer' header flows through URL decoding and HTML encoding via ESAPI.encodeForHTML() into the HTTP response body. While encoded, the Referer header content is inherently untrusted and contains arbitrary user-supplied data which can still trigger reflected XSS attacks against other users viewing the page. The X-XSS-Protection header being disabled further confirms intentional testing of XSS vectors.

evidence.note: Data flow from request headers to response writer showing user input reaches the sink
